title: Function calling and other API updates
summary: We’re announcing updates including more steerable API models, function calling capabilities, longer context, and lower prices.
body: We’re announcing updates including more steerable API models, function calling capabilities, longer context, and lower prices.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了多项API更新，包括支持更可控的模型行为、全新的函数调用（Function Calling）功能、更长的上下文窗口以及大幅降低的API价格，极大扩展了开发者将大模型与外部系统结合的能力。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI宣布了API的重大更新，引入函数调用（Function Calling）及更强的可控性，对LLM在现实应用中的开发落地具有深远影响。
